fixes: soften the turret edges (cast radius) so it is not a sharp-edged box

proportions.reason: 6.8 x 3.1 x 2.5 m against the 6.68 x 3.00 x 2.45 m spec; wheel 830 mm, track 550 mm and barrel pass the measures.

materials.reason: Green paint reads, rubber tyres read, spare links read rust-red; but the track links read as brown wooden slats under raking light, and the chips are uniform black dots spread over every plate like spatter.

edge-biased chipping instead of uniform dots
